Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: curunir
Message:
Fleet secrets live on the board: admins set them on /fleet, keepers write fleet.env

An admin sets GH_TOKEN (and other *_TOKEN/_KEY/_SECRET) under Secrets on /fleet.
Each keeper report returns the secrets' version; on a change the keeper fetches
the values (keepers that report a box only) and writes fleet.env, mode 600.
bin/bot re-reads fleet.env before every harness run, so a rotated or removed
token takes effect on the next run without restarts. Replaces #85's ssh copy
(KEEPER_FLEET_ENV); a hand-kept fleet.env is left alone while the board has none.
